inclusions.text: Hotel pickup by a Travel2Egypt representative in an air-conditioned vehicle
inclusions.source: A Travel2Egypt representative will collect you in an air-conditioned vehicle at the scheduled pickup time and drive you out to the Giza Plateau.
When the show closes, your representative meets you and transfers you back to your hotel.

inclusions.text: Translation headsets, free of charge in nine languages
inclusions.source: Headsets providing commentary translation are available free of charge in nine languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Polish, and Arabic.
